narratives.Overview:
## Why

TS 7.0 has no stable programmatic API. A direct `typescript` major to 7 breaks `typescript-eslint`. Official guidance is side-by-side until ~7.1.

## Locked decisions

- **D1 — Primary surface:** `## TypeScript 7 side-by-side (pre-7.1)` in `content/languages/typescript.md` (aliases + Dependabot ignore + links). ALREADY SHIPPED on branch.
- **D2 — UPGRADING pointer:** Short top-of-`content/UPGRADING.md` note. ALREADY SHIPPED.
- **D3 — Scaffold bake: DEFER.** Unchanged — no Deft-owned TS package.json scaffold.
- **D4 — Doctor / verify hint: SHIP (operator flip).** Advisory `deft doctor` check (install-integrity / checks.ts): when package.json has typescript-eslint (`typescript-eslint` or `@typescript-eslint/*`) AND `typescript` declares a 7.x range (or npm:typescript@7) AND the `typescript` value is NOT the `@typescript/typescript6` alias → warning pointing at languages/typescript.md side-by-side section. Exit-exempt (like gitignore-coverage). Wire into runChecksImpl + main.ts advisory warning list + unit tests. Update docs/CHANGELOG that previously said doctor deferred.
- **D5 — Contract test:** Update content contract — doctor shipped, scaffold still deferred.
- **D6 — CHANGELOG:** Update `[Unreleased]` entry for #2591 to mention doctor hint shipped; scaffold still deferred.
- **D7 — Out of scope:** Changing this repo's root package.json typescript pin; scaffold bake.

## Remaining work (this amendment)

- [ ] Doctor check + tests + exit-exempt wiring
- [ ] Flip typescript.md / UPGRADING / CHANGELOG / content-contract text from doctor-deferred → doctor-shipped
- [ ] `task scope:complete`, PR Closes #2591, merge
